body: According to Ceddy Nash, who was present at NBA Ben10’s court hearing, the judge reportedly told guards to put NBA Ben10 in a diaper after guards complained that they didn’t have enough staff to deal with it if he needed to be cleaned while in court and said they didn’t know what to do. Allegations are not findings of guilt.
